decisions.choice: Darius son of Ahasuerus, a Mede: the king of 6:1
decisions.reason: Darius the Mede is the king who received the kingdom when Babylon fell (6:1). No such king is known outside the book of Daniel, and he is identified in different ways: as a throne name of Cyrus himself, as Gubaru (Cyrus's governor of Babylon), or otherwise; see the note at 6:1. Ahasuerus is the name the Hebrew Bible gives to the Persian king Xerxes (Esther 1:1); this Ahasuerus is not otherwise known.

decisions.choice: who was made king: he received the kingship from another
decisions.reason: The verb is passive: Darius was made king, by Cyrus or by God. Compare 6:1, "Darius the Mede received the kingdom". The year is about 539-538 BC, the first year after the fall of Babylon.

decisions.choice: the Babylonians (R)
decisions.reason: The table for Daniel gives "Chaldeans" at Literal and Balanced and "Babylonians" at Readable where the word means the people. The sentence runs on into verse 2; Literal ends this verse with a comma, and Balanced makes it a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: Dario; Assuero; os caldeus (L, B), os babilônios (R)
decisions.reason: The names take their usual Brazilian forms, "Dario" (to be aligned with chapter 6) and "Assuero" as in Esther's Portuguese; "caldeus" and "babilônios" follow the table for Daniel at each level.

decisions.choice: "Darius fils d'Assuérus" at every level; "les Chaldéens" (L, B), "les Babyloniens" (R)
decisions.reason: Names as the term sheet gives them for Daniel: Ahasuerus is "Assuérus" as in the published French; the Chaldeans as a people are "les Babyloniens" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Wakaldayo" (L, B); "Wababeli" (R) for the Chaldeans as a people
decisions.reason: As the Swahili term sheet and 2 Chronicles 36:17: Readable names the people a new reader knows, as the English Readable says "Babylonians".

decisions.choice: "Đa-ri-út", "A-suê-ru", "người Mê-đi"; "người Canh-đê" (L, B) / "người Ba-by-lôn" (R)
decisions.reason: The published forms of Ezra and Esther, as the term sheet gives them. Kasdim here is the people, so Readable says "người Ba-by-lôn", as the English Readable says "Babylonians".

decisions.choice: "아하수에로의 아들 다리오", "메대"; "갈대아 사람들" (L, B) and "바빌로니아 사람들" (R) for the Chaldeans as a people
decisions.reason: The names as the term sheet gives them (Darius as in Ezra); the Chaldeans as a people become "바빌로니아 사람들" at Readable, as the English Readable says Babylonians.

decisions.choice: The sentence runs on into verse 2 at L and R, ending in a comma, as the English does; Balanced closes it as its own sentence
decisions.reason: The Hebrew's date clause belongs to verse 2; each verse keeps its own content.

decisions.choice: "Darío hijo de Asuero"; "los medos"
decisions.reason: The published forms of the names (Ezra; Esther); this is the king called "Darío el medo" in 6:1

decisions.choice: "los babilonios" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the Chaldeans are the people, so R says "los babilonios", as in 1:4

records.literal_gloss: in year one of his reigning, I, Daniel, observed in the scrolls the number of the years, which came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah the prophet, to complete for [the] desolations of Jerusalem: seventy years.

en.L: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, perceived in the scrolls the number of the years which, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to Jeremiah the prophet, were to be completed for the desolations of Jerusalem: seventy years.
en.B: In the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, came to understand from the scriptures the number of years that, according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the prophet Jeremiah, must pass before the desolation of Jerusalem would come to an end: seventy years.
en.R: I, Daniel, was studying the scrolls. I read the message that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had given to the prophet Jeremiah. It said that Jerusalem would lie in ruins for seventy years.

pt.L: no primeiro ano do seu reinado, eu, Daniel, percebi nos rolos o número dos anos que, segundo a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ao profeta Jeremias, haviam de se cumprir para as desolações de Jerusalém: setenta anos.
pt.B: No primeiro ano do seu reinado, eu, Daniel, entendi pelas Escrituras o número de anos que, segundo a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ao profeta Jeremias, deviam passar até que terminasse a desolação de Jerusalém: setenta anos.
pt.R: eu, Daniel, estava estudando os rolos. Li a mensagem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dado ao profeta Jeremias. Ela dizia que Jerusalém ficaria em ruínas durante setenta anos.

fr.L: la première année de son règne, moi, Daniel, je discernai dans les livres le nombre des années selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [adressée] à Jérémie le prophète, [qui devaient] s’accomplir pour les ruines de Jérusalem : soixante-dix ans.
fr.B: La première année de son règne, moi, Daniel, je compris, en lisant les Écritures, le nombre d’années qui, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au prophète Jérémie, devaient passer avant que prennent fin les ruines de Jérusalem : soixante-dix ans.
fr.R: moi, Daniel, j’étudiais les livres. J’ai lu le message que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait donné au prophète Jérémie. Il disait que Jérusalem resterait en ruine pendant soixante-dix ans.

es.L: en el año primero de su reinado, yo, Daniel, comprendí en los rollos el número de los años que, según la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al profeta Jeremías, habían de cumplirse sobre las desolaciones de Jerusalén: setenta años.
es.B: En el primer año de su reinado, yo, Daniel, llegué a entender por las Escrituras el número de años que, según la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} al profeta Jeremías, debían pasar antes de que terminara la desolación de Jerusalén: setenta años.
es.R: yo, Daniel, estaba estudiando los rollos. Leí el mensaje que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había dado al profeta Jeremías. Decía que Jerusalén estaría en ruinas durante setenta años.

sw.L: katika mwaka wa kwanza wa kutawala kwake, mimi Danieli nilifahamu katika magombo hesabu ya miaka ambayo, kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa Yeremia nabii, ingetimizwa kwa ajili ya ukiwa wa Yerusalemu: miaka sabini.

vi.L: vào năm thứ nhất của triều đại người, tôi, Đa-ni-ên, đã nhận thấy trong các cuộn sách số năm mà, theo lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với Giê-rê-mi, nhà tiên tri, phải được mãn cho những sự hoang tàn của Giê-ru-sa-lem: bảy mươi năm.

vi.R: tôi, Đa-ni-ên, đang nghiên cứu các cuộn sách. Tôi đọc sứ điệp {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho nhà tiên tri Giê-rê-mi. Sứ điệp ấy nói rằng Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ nằm trong cảnh đổ nát suốt bảy mươi năm.

ko.L: 그의 통치 제1년에, 나 다니엘은 두루마리 책들에서, 예언자 예레미야에게 임한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로 예루살렘의 황폐함이 다 차기까지 [걸릴] 햇수, 곧 70년을 깨달았다.
ko.B: 그가 다스린 첫해에, 나 다니엘은 성경 두루마리들을 읽다가, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 예레미야에게 하신 말씀대로 예루살렘이 황폐한 채로 지나야 할 햇수가 70년이라는 것을 깨달았다.
ko.R: 나 다니엘은 두루마리 책들을 읽고 있었다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 예언자 예레미야에게 주신 말씀을 읽었다. 그 말씀에 따르면 예루살렘은 70년 동안 폐허로 남아 있을 것이었다.

decisions.choice: seventy years: the word of the LORD to Jeremiah
decisions.reason: Jeremiah said that the land would be a ruin and the nations would serve the king of Babylon for seventy years (Jeremiah 25:11-12), and that after seventy years for Babylon the LORD would bring his people home (Jeremiah 29:10). 2 Chronicles 36:21 links the seventy years with the sabbath rests the land had missed (Leviticus 26:34-35). Daniel, in the year Babylon fell, sees that the time is nearly over, and he prays.

decisions.choice: the scrolls: the written books, including Jeremiah's prophecy
decisions.reason: The word means writings or books. Jeremiah's words were written on scrolls (Jeremiah 29:1; 36:2), and Daniel reads them as a word of the LORD.

decisions.choice: the desolations of Jerusalem: the ruined state of the city
decisions.reason: The word is from the root used for desolation throughout these chapters (8:13; 9:17-18, 26-27). Jerusalem had lain in ruins since 587 BC.

decisions.choice: the scriptures (B); the scrolls (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "scriptures", since the scrolls are the written word of the prophets; Readable keeps "scrolls". Readable makes the long sentence into three and drops the date, which the previous verse gives.

decisions.choice: setenta anos
decisions.reason: The number is written as Jeremiah 25:11-12 has it in Portuguese ("setenta anos", "os setenta anos"), so the reader meets the same words in the prophecy and in the verse that quotes it (m1).

decisions.choice: "les livres" (L, R), "les Écritures" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names written books; Balanced says "les Écritures" as the English Balanced "the scriptures". Readable keeps a plain word; "rouleaux" would need explaining.

decisions.choice: "magombo" (L, R); "Maandiko" (B) for the scrolls
decisions.reason: "Gombo" is the published word for a scroll (Luke 4:17); Balanced says "Maandiko" as the English Balanced says "the scriptures". "Miaka sabini" is the wording of Jeremiah 25:11 and 2 Chronicles 36:21.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA" in a divine_name span ("Gia-vê" as the alternative)
decisions.reason: The divine name appears in Daniel only in chapter 9. It is written as everywhere in the Vietnamese Old Testament, with its particles outside the span. "Lord" (Adonai) in the same prayer is "Chúa" in ordinary letters.

decisions.choice: "các cuộn sách" (L, R); "các sách thánh" (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced follows the English "the scriptures" without the capitalised "Kinh Thánh", which would name the finished Bible; "bảy mươi năm" is the wording of Jeremiah 25:11 and 29:10.

decisions.choice: "70년" in figures at every level
decisions.reason: Years are in figures, and Jeremiah 25:11 and 29:10 say "70년", so the allusion is visible.

decisions.choice: "두루마리 책들" (L, R); "성경 두루마리들" (B)
decisions.reason: The scroll is "두루마리 책" as the term sheet sets for Jeremiah; Balanced adds "성경" as the English Balanced says "the scriptures".

decisions.choice: "los rollos" (L, R); "las Escrituras" (B)
decisions.reason: As the English levels; "rollo" is the word of Jeremiah 36 in Spanish

decisions.choice: R begins in lowercase
decisions.reason: The English R splits 9:1–2 so that verse 1 ends with a comma and verse 2 goes on with "I, Daniel"; Spanish R follows that division

source.text: וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה אֶת־פָּנַ֗י אֶל־אֲדֹנָי֙ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ תְּפִלָּ֖ה וְתַחֲנוּנִ֑ים בְּצ֖וֹם וְשַׂ֥ק וָאֵֽפֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: And I set my face to the Lord God, to seek prayer and supplications with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

en.L: And I set my face toward the Lord God, to seek [him by] prayer and pleas for mercy, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.
en.B: So I turned to the Lord God, seeking {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in prayer and pleading for mercy, with fasting, in sackcloth and ashes.
en.R: So I turned to the Lord God and prayed. I begged {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} for mercy. I fasted, wore rough clothing and put ashes on my head.

pt.L: E voltei o meu rosto para o Senhor Deus, para buscar oração e súplicas, com jejum, pano de saco e cinza.
pt.B: Então me voltei para o Senhor Deus, buscando-{{deity_pronoun:o|O}} em oração e pedindo misericórdia, com jejum, vestido de pano de saco e coberto de cinza.
pt.R: Então me voltei para o Senhor Deus e orei. Implorei a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} que tivesse misericórdia. Jejuei, vesti roupa de pano grosseiro e pus cinza na cabeça.

fr.L: Et je tournai ma face vers le Seigneur Dieu, pour [le] chercher par la prière et les supplications, avec le jeûne, le sac et la cendre.
fr.B: Je me tournai donc vers le Seigneur Dieu pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} chercher par la prière et les supplications, en jeûnant, vêtu d’un sac et couvert de cendre.
fr.R: Alors je me suis tourné vers le Seigneur Dieu et j’ai prié. Je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ai demandé d’avoir pitié. J’ai jeûné, j’ai porté des vêtements de deuil grossiers et j’ai mis de la cendre sur ma tête.

es.L: Y puse mi rostro hacia el Señor Dios, para buscar[lo] con oración y súplicas, con ayuno, cilicio y ceniza.
es.B: Así que me volví hacia el Señor Dios y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} busqué en oración, suplicando {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} misericordia, con ayuno, vestido de cilicio y cubierto de ceniza.
es.R: Entonces me volví hacia el Señor Dios, oré y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} supliqué que tuviera compasión. Ayuné, me vestí con ropa áspera de luto y me puse ceniza en la cabeza.

sw.L: Nami nikaukaza uso wangu kwa Bwana Mungu, ili [kumtafuta kwa] maombi na kusihi, kwa kufunga na kwa magunia na majivu.
sw.B: Basi nikamgeukia Bwana Mungu, nikimtafuta kwa maombi na kumsihi anihurumie, huku nikifunga, nimevaa magunia na kujipaka majivu.
sw.R: Basi nilimgeukia Bwana Mungu, nikaomba. Nilimsihi anihurumie. Nilifunga, nikavaa nguo za magunia na kujipaka majivu kichwani.

vi.L: Và tôi xây mặt về phía Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời, để tìm kiếm [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng] lời cầu nguyện và những lời nài xin, với sự kiêng ăn, vải thô và tro.
vi.B: Vậy tôi quay mặt về phía Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời, tìm kiếm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng lời cầu nguyện và nài xin thương xót, trong sự kiêng ăn, mặc vải thô và ngồi trong tro.
vi.R: Vì vậy tôi quay về với Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời và cầu nguyện. Tôi nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thương xót. Tôi kiêng ăn, mặc áo vải thô và rắc tro lên đầu.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 주 하나님께 내 얼굴을 향하고, 금식하며 굵은 베옷을 입고 재를 쓰고, 기도와 간구로 [그분을] 찾았다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 주 하나님께 얼굴을 돌려, 금식하며 굵은 베옷을 입고 재를 뒤집어쓴 채 기도와 간구로 그분을 찾았다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 주 하나님께 기도했다. 나는 그분께 불쌍히 여겨 달라고 간절히 빌었다. 나는 음식을 먹지 않고, 거친 베옷을 입고, 머리에 재를 뒤집어썼다.

decisions.choice: I set my face toward the Lord God: I turned to him with resolve
decisions.reason: To set one's face is to turn toward something with fixed purpose (2 Kings 12:18; Jeremiah 42:15). Daniel may also have faced toward Jerusalem, as he did in 6:11 (1 Kings 8:48).

decisions.choice: fasting, sackcloth and ashes: signs of grief and repentance
decisions.reason: Sackcloth was rough cloth of goat's hair worn in mourning, and ashes were put on the head or sat in (Nehemiah 9:1; Jonah 3:6; Esther 4:1). Together with fasting they show humble sorrow before God.

decisions.choice: the Lord: the title Adonai
decisions.reason: Daniel calls on God by the title "Lord" (Adonai) here and throughout the prayer (verses 4, 7, 9, 15-17, 19), and by the divine name in verses 4, 8, 10, 13-14 and 20.

decisions.choice: wore rough clothing and put ashes on my head (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what sackcloth and ashes were (m2).

records.literal_gloss: And I prayed to Yahweh my God and confessed, and I said: Ah, Lord, the God, the great and the awesome, keeping the covenant and the loyal love for those loving him and for those keeping his commandments,

en.L: And I prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God and made confession, and said, "Ah, Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps the covenant and the loyal love with those who love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments,
en.B: I prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God and confessed, saying, "Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} covenant and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love with those who love {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments,
en.R: I prayed to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} my God and confessed our sins. I said, "Lord, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the great and awesome God. You keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} covenant and show faithful love to those who love {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.

pt.L: E orei {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, meu Deus, e fiz confissão, e disse: "Ah, Senhor, o Deus grande e temível, que guarda a aliança e o amor leal para com os que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} amam e guardam os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos,
pt.B: Orei {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, meu Deus, e fiz a minha confissão, dizendo: "Ah, Senhor, o grande e temível Deus, que guarda a aliança e o amor leal para com os que {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} amam e obedecem aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos,
pt.R: Orei {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, meu Deus, e confessei os nossos pecados. Eu disse: "Senhor, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o grande e temível Deus. Tu guardas a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} aliança e mostras amor fiel aos que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} amam e obedecem aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos.

fr.L: Et je priai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu et je fis [ma] confession, et je dis : « Ah ! Seigneur, le Dieu grand et redoutable, qui garde l’alliance et l’amour loyal envers ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}aiment et qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements,
fr.B: Je priai {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu et je fis ma confession, en disant : « Seigneur, Dieu grand et redoutable, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} gardes {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} alliance et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle envers ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}aiment et gardent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: J’ai prié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu et j’ai reconnu nos péchés. J’ai dit : « Seigneur, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le Dieu grand et redoutable. Tu gardes {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} alliance et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} montres {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle à ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}aiment et qui obéissent à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

es.B: Oré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} mi Dios e hice confesión, diciendo: «¡Señor, Dios grande y temible, que guarda {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pacto y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel con los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} aman y guardan {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos!
es.R: Oré {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} mi Dios y confesé nuestros pecados. Dije: «Señor, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Dios grande y temible. Cumples {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pacto y muestras amor fiel a los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} aman y obedecen {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.

sw.L: Nami nikaomba kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nikaungama, nikasema, "Ee Bwana, Mungu mkuu na wa kutisha, mwenye kulishika agano na upendo usiokoma kwa wanaompenda na kwa wanaozishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}},
sw.B: Nilimwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nikaungama, nikisema, "Ee Bwana, Mungu mkuu na wa kutisha, unayelishika agano {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma kwa wale wanaokupenda na kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}},

vi.L: Và tôi cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi và xưng tội, và thưa: "Ôi, lạy Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại và đáng kính sợ, Đấng giữ giao ước và tình yêu thương thành tín với những người yêu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Tôi cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi và xưng tội rằng: "Lạy Chúa, Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại và đáng kính sợ, Đấng giữ giao ước và tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với những người yêu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vâng giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Tôi cầu nguyện với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của tôi và xưng tội của chúng tôi. Tôi thưa: "Lạy Chúa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại và đáng kính sợ. Ngài giữ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và tỏ tình thương thành tín với những người yêu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vâng giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 나의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하며 자백하여 말했다. "아, 주님, 크고 두려우신 하나님, 그분을 사랑하고 그분의 계명들을 지키는 자들에게 언약과 한결같은 사랑을 지키시는 분이시여,
ko.B: 나는 나의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하며 죄를 자백했다. "주님, 크고 두려우신 하나님, 그분을 사랑하고 그분의 계명을 지키는 사람들에게 언약과 한결같은 사랑을 지키시는 하나님,
ko.R: 나는 나의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 기도하며 우리의 죄를 고백했다. "주님, 주님은 크고 두려우신 하나님이십니다. 주님은 주님을 사랑하고 주님의 계명에 순종하는 사람들에게 언약을 지키시고 변함없는 사랑을 베푸십니다.

decisions.choice: the great and awesome God, who keeps covenant and loyal love: Deuteronomy 7:9, 21
decisions.reason: The words are those of Deuteronomy 7:9 ("the faithful God, who keeps covenant and loyal love with those who love him and keep his commandments") and 7:21 ("a great and awesome God"). Nehemiah's prayers open in the same words (Nehemiah 1:5; 9:32). Daniel's prayer is built from the language of the law and the prophets.

decisions.choice: hesed: loyal love, God's faithful kindness within the covenant
decisions.reason: The word means steadfast, faithful love that keeps a bond. Here it is paired with "the covenant": God keeps his covenant and the love he has promised in it.

decisions.choice: Ah: a word of earnest pleading
decisions.reason: The word opens a plea or confession with urgency (Nehemiah 1:5, 11; Jonah 1:14).

decisions.choice: confessed: the prayer is a confession of the people's sin
decisions.reason: The prayer (verses 4-19) confesses the sin of Israel, says that God was right to punish, and asks him to act for his own name's sake. It is like the prayers of Ezra 9 and Nehemiah 1 and 9, and asks for what Solomon's prayer foresaw (1 Kings 8:46-53).

decisions.choice: loyal love (L, B); faithful love (R)
decisions.reason: Hesed follows the wording set for the prophets: "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced, "faithful love" at Readable. Nehemiah 1:5 and Deuteronomy 7:9, which this verse echoes, were published with "steadfast love" at Literal; the founder's ruling on quotations of Exodus 34:6 is still open, and this wording follows the prophets until it is given.

decisions.choice: you, your, him, his for God (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: Daniel's prayer speaks to God as "you" and about him as "he"; every such pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting, except at the start of a sentence. The prayer is set in double quotation marks from here to the end of verse 19.

decisions.choice: the LORD (divine name); Lord (Adonai); no "O"
decisions.reason: The divine name is written as a setting span. "Ah" at Literal keeps the pleading word; Balanced and Readable begin with the vocative "Lord" alone, with no "O", as the vocative is written in the prophets.

decisions.choice: Ah, Senhor (L, B); Senhor (R)
decisions.reason: The pleading word (m3) is "Ah", as Jeremiah's Portuguese has "Ah, Senhor DEUS" where the Hebrew has Adonai with the divine name; here Adonai stands alone, so it is "Senhor", with only its first letter in capitals, as the Old Testament terms set it. Balanced keeps "Ah", which Portuguese uses in earnest prayer; Readable starts with "Senhor", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: tu to God, with deity_pronoun spans, for the whole prayer (9:4-19); the words of Nehemiah 1:5
decisions.reason: Daniel speaks to God with "tu", as every prayer does in Portuguese (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4), and every pronoun for God takes the deity_pronoun span except a "Tu" that opens a sentence. The opening keeps the confession wording of Nehemiah 1:5 and 9:32 in Portuguese ("o grande e temível Deus, que guarda a aliança e o amor leal para com os que o amam"), since all three prayers take up Deuteronomy 7:9, 21 (m1). Readable says "amor fiel", as the English Readable says "faithful love".

decisions.choice: "l'amour loyal" (L), "amour fidèle" (B, R) for hesed, with Deuteronomy 7:9's "qui garde l'alliance"
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for these books; the phrase echoes Deuteronomy 7:9, whose published French keeps "garde l'alliance" and "ceux qui l'aiment".

decisions.choice: Daniel's prayer (verses 4-19) speaks to God as "tu", with deity_pronoun spans on "tu", "te", "toi", "ton", "ta", "tes"; the prayer is speech, so its past is in the passé composé at every level; it is one quotation, closed at verse 19
decisions.reason: French Bibles today address God as "tu", as the style guide asks; Literal keeps the Hebrew's third person where it has it ("ceux qui l'aiment"), Balanced and Readable turn the address into the second person as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Ee Bwana, Mungu mkuu na wa kutisha", with the vocative "Ee"
decisions.reason: The address the Swahili term sheet sets for Daniel's prayer; Swahili marks a solemn address to God with "Ee", as the published Psalms do, where the English has no "O". Literal keeps the Hebrew third person ("wanaompenda") with the wording of Deuteronomy 7:9 L; Balanced turns to "you", as Swahili prayer does.

decisions.choice: "upendo usiokoma" for hesed at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word for hesed, as Deuteronomy 7:9, Isaiah, Jeremiah and the Psalms.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "tình thương thành tín" (R)
decisions.reason: Hesed in the prophets' wording. The verse echoes Deuteronomy 7:9 and 1 Kings 8:23, and their published Vietnamese is kept: "Đấng giữ giao ước và tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B), "tình thương thành tín" (Deuteronomy 7:9 R).

decisions.choice: In the prayer Daniel says "con", the people "chúng con", and God is "Ngài" or "Chúa"
decisions.reason: The address of prayer in the Vietnamese Old Testament (Ezra 9:6; 1 Kings 8:47). In his narration Daniel still calls himself "tôi". "Ôi, lạy Chúa" (L) keeps the pleading "Ah"; Balanced and Readable drop it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Daniel's prayer (9:4-19) is in 합쇼체 with 저/저희, addressing God as "주님" and "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여"; "our God" is "저희 하나님" and "my God" "저의 하나님" (L) / "제 하나님" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for Daniel 9 and as Ezra 9 prays; the narration around the prayer stays in the plain style with 나.

decisions.choice: "크고 두려우신 하나님"; "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for "the great and awesome God" and for hesed; the covenant phrase echoes Deuteronomy 7:9 as published ("언약과 한결같은 사랑을 지키시는").

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (L); "amor fiel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for hesed in the prophets; the phrase echoes Deuteronomy 7:9, 21 ("Dios grande y temible")

decisions.choice: the opening address closed with ¡ ... ! within the verse
decisions.reason: The English address runs on into verse 5 with a comma; Spanish closes it as an exclamation so that every ¡ is closed in the same rendering, and verse 5 begins a new sentence. Daniel speaks to God with "tú" through the prayer (9:4–19), and the « » opens here and closes at the end of verse 19

source.text: חָטָ֥אנוּ וְעָוִ֖ינוּ הִרְשַׁ֣עְנוּ וּמָרָ֑דְנוּ וְס֥וֹר מִמִּצְוֺתֶ֖ךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: We have sinned and done iniquity, and acted wickedly and rebelled, and turned aside from your commandments and from your judgments.

en.L: We have sinned and committed iniquity and acted wickedly and rebelled, turning aside from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commandments and from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments.
en.B: We have sinned and done wrong; we have been wicked and have rebelled, turning away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commandments and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rules.
en.R: We have sinned and done wrong. We have been wicked and have turned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. We have turned away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

pt.L: Pecamos e cometemos iniquidade, e agimos impiamente, e nos rebelamos, desviando-nos dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos e dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} juízos.
pt.B: Pecamos e fizemos o mal; fomos ímpios e nos rebelamos, afastando-nos dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos e das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} ordenanças.
pt.R: Pecamos e fizemos coisas erradas. Fomos maus e nos rebelamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Abandonamos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos e as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} leis.

fr.L: Nous avons péché et nous avons commis l’iniquité, et nous avons agi méchamment et nous nous sommes révoltés, en nous détournant de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements et de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements.
fr.B: Nous avons péché, nous avons mal agi, nous avons été méchants et nous nous sommes révoltés, nous nous sommes détournés de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements et de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} règles.
fr.R: Nous avons péché et nous avons fait le mal. Nous avons été méchants et nous nous sommes révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Nous nous sommes détournés de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements et de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

es.L: Hemos pecado, hemos cometido iniquidad, hemos actuado impíamente y nos hemos rebelado, apartándonos de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos y de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decretos.
es.B: Hemos pecado y hemos hecho lo malo; hemos sido impíos y nos hemos rebelado, apartándonos de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos y de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} normas.
es.R: Hemos pecado y hemos hecho lo malo. Hemos sido malvados y nos hemos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Nos hemos apartado de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos y de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes.

sw.L: Tumetenda dhambi na kukosa, tumetenda uovu na kuasi, tukageuka mbali na amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} na hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Tumetenda dhambi na kukosa; tumetenda uovu na kuasi, tukaziacha amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} na maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Tumetenda dhambi na kufanya mabaya. Tumekuwa waovu, tumekuasi. Tumeziacha amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} na sheria {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

vi.L: Chúng con đã phạm tội, và làm điều gian ác, và đã hành động độc ác, và đã phản nghịch, xây bỏ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và các mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chúng con đã phạm tội và làm điều sai trái; chúng con đã làm điều ác và đã phản nghịch, lìa bỏ các điều răn và mạng lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Chúng con đã phạm tội và làm điều sai trái. Chúng con đã làm điều ác và chống nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chúng con đã bỏ các điều răn và các quy định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 저희가 죄를 짓고 죄악을 저지르고 악을 행하고 반역하여, 주님의 계명들과 주님의 법도에서 떠났습니다.
ko.B: 저희는 죄를 짓고 잘못을 저질렀습니다. 악한 일을 하고 반역하여, 주님의 계명과 법도에서 떠났습니다.
ko.R: 저희는 죄를 짓고 잘못을 저질렀습니다. 저희는 악한 일을 하고 주님께 반역했습니다. 저희는 주님의 계명과 규칙을 저버렸습니다.

decisions.choice: we have sinned, done wrong, acted wickedly: the confession of 1 Kings 8:47
decisions.reason: Solomon's prayer gave these words as the confession Israel would make in exile (1 Kings 8:47; compare Psalm 106:6). Daniel makes it, and adds "and rebelled".

decisions.choice: judgments: the ordinances, God's rulings in the law
decisions.reason: The word means decisions or rulings, and in the law the specific rules God gave (Deuteronomy 4:1).

decisions.choice: your (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: The pronouns for God take the deity_pronoun setting. Balanced says "been wicked" for the third verb.

decisions.choice: os juízos (L); as ordenanças (B)
decisions.reason: As Nehemiah 1:7 in Portuguese: "juízos" at Literal, as the English says "judgments", and "ordenanças" at Balanced, the Old Testament term for God's rules.

decisions.choice: "Nous avons péché ... nous avons mal agi" (B), the confession of 1 Kings 8:47
decisions.reason: The meaning decision points to Solomon's prayer; the Balanced words follow the published French of 1 Kings 8:47 so the echo can be heard.

decisions.choice: "Tumetenda dhambi na kukosa; tumetenda uovu" as 1 Kings 8:47; mishpatim "hukumu" (L), "maagizo" (B), "sheria" (R)
decisions.reason: The confession echoes Solomon's prayer, so its first words follow the published 1 Kings 8:47. The split for mishpatim is the one the term sheet sets for Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "mạng lệnh" (L, B); "quy định" (R) for mishpatim
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word for mishpatim, kept apart from "luật lệ" (statutes). The confession "phạm tội và làm điều sai trái" is the published wording of 1 Kings 8:47.

decisions.choice: "법도" (L, B); "규칙" (R) for mishpatim
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for mishpatim; the confession echoes 1 Kings 8:47 as published ("죄를 지었습니다. 잘못을 저지르고 악을 행했습니다").

decisions.choice: "decretos" (L); "normas" (B); "leyes" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording for mishpatim settled for Ezekiel; the opening echoes the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:47

source.text: וְלֹ֤א שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ֙ אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבְּרוּ֙ בְּשִׁמְךָ֔ אֶל־מְלָכֵ֥ינוּ שָׂרֵ֖ינוּ וַאֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ וְאֶ֖ל כָּל־עַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And not we have listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our leaders and our fathers and to all [the] people of the land.

en.L: And we have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants the prophets, who in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name spoke to our kings, our princes and our fathers, and to the whole people of the land.
en.B: We did not listen to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants the prophets when they spoke in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name to our kings, our officials and our ancestors, and to all the people of the land.
en.R: We have not listened to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants the prophets. They spoke for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to our kings and leaders and ancestors, and to all the people in the land.

pt.L: E não ouvimos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} servos, os profetas, que em {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome falaram aos nossos reis, aos nossos príncipes e aos nossos pais, e a todo o povo da terra.
pt.B: Não demos ouvidos aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} servos, os profetas, quando falaram em {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome aos nossos reis, aos nossos oficiais, aos nossos antepassados e a todo o povo da terra.
pt.R: Não ouvimos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} servos, os profetas. Eles falaram da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} parte aos nossos reis, aos nossos líderes, aos nossos antepassados e a todo o povo da terra.

fr.L: Et nous n’avons pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs les prophètes, qui ont parlé en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à nos rois, à nos chefs et à nos pères, et à tout le peuple du pays.
fr.B: Nous n’avons pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs les prophètes, quand ils parlaient en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom à nos rois, à nos dignitaires, à nos ancêtres et à tout le peuple du pays.
fr.R: Nous n’avons pas écouté {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs les prophètes. Ils ont parlé de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} part à nos rois, à nos chefs, à nos ancêtres et à tout le peuple du pays.

es.L: Y no hemos escuchado a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos los profetas, que en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre hablaron a nuestros reyes, a nuestros príncipes y a nuestros padres, y a todo el pueblo de la tierra.
es.B: No escuchamos a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos los profetas cuando hablaron en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre a nuestros reyes, a nuestros jefes y a nuestros antepasados, y a todo el pueblo del país.
es.R: No hemos escuchado a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos los profetas. Ellos hablaron de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} parte a nuestros reyes, a nuestros dirigentes y a nuestros antepasados, y a toda la gente del país.

sw.L: Wala hatukuwasikiliza watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} manabii, waliosema kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} na wafalme wetu, wakuu wetu na baba zetu, na watu wote wa nchi.
sw.B: Hatukuwasikiliza watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} manabii walipozungumza kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} na wafalme wetu, maafisa wetu na mababu zetu, na watu wote wa nchi.
sw.R: Hatukuwasikiliza watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} manabii. Waliwapelekea wafalme wetu, viongozi wetu, mababu zetu na watu wote wa nchi ujumbe {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.

vi.L: Và chúng con đã không nghe các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri, là những người đã nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với các vua của chúng con, các thủ lĩnh của chúng con, và tổ phụ chúng con, cùng với toàn dân trong xứ.
vi.B: Chúng con đã không nghe các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri, khi họ nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với các vua, các quan chức và tổ tiên của chúng con, cùng với toàn dân trong xứ.
vi.R: Chúng con đã không nghe các đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri. Họ đã thay mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với các vua, các nhà lãnh đạo, tổ tiên của chúng con, và mọi người dân trong xứ.

ko.L: 그리고 저희는 주님의 이름으로 저희 왕들과 저희 고관들과 저희 조상들과 그 땅의 모든 백성에게 말한 주님의 종 예언자들의 [말을] 듣지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 저희는 주님의 종 예언자들이 주님의 이름으로 저희 왕들과 관리들과 조상들과 그 땅의 모든 백성에게 말할 때에 듣지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 저희는 주님의 종 예언자들의 말을 듣지 않았습니다. 그들은 주님을 대신하여 저희 왕들과 지도자들과 조상들과 그 땅의 모든 백성에게 말했습니다.

decisions.choice: your servants the prophets: the phrase of Jeremiah and Kings
decisions.reason: The phrase is common in Jeremiah (7:25; 25:4; 26:5) and in Kings (2 Kings 17:13, 23). God sent his prophets again and again, and the people did not listen.

decisions.choice: princes: the officials of the royal court
decisions.reason: The word means leaders or officials, the men who served under the king (Jeremiah 26:10-12).

decisions.choice: servants (all levels); princes (L), officials (B), leaders (R); fathers (L), ancestors (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Your servants the prophets" is kept at every level, as the prophets' "my servants" is published in Jeremiah 7:25. Sar for human officials follows the wording settled for the prophets (officials, leaders); Literal keeps "princes" here, as Nehemiah 9:32 does in a list of the same kind.

decisions.choice: your (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: The pronouns for God take the deity_pronoun setting. Readable says "spoke for you" for "spoke in your name".

decisions.choice: os teus servos, os profetas (every level); príncipes (L), oficiais (B), líderes (R)
decisions.reason: "Servos" at every level, as Jeremiah 7:25's Portuguese has "os meus servos, os profetas" and the English keeps "servants" here; the officials follow Nehemiah 9:32 in Portuguese ("príncipes", "oficiais", "líderes").

decisions.choice: "nos chefs" (L, R), "nos dignitaires" (B) for sarim at the court
decisions.reason: The term sheet gives "les chefs" for sarim; here the meaning decision names the officials of the royal court, which Balanced makes plain with "dignitaires".

decisions.choice: "các đầy tớ của Ngài là các nhà tiên tri" at every level
decisions.reason: God's servants are "đầy tớ" at every level, as in Jeremiah 25:4. Sarim are "thủ lĩnh" (L, as Kings) / "quan chức" (B) / "nhà lãnh đạo" (R), following the English officials and leaders.

decisions.choice: "고관들" (L); "관리들" (B); "지도자들" (R) for sarim; "주님의 종 예언자들" at every level
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for sarim; the prophets as God's servants keep "종" at every level, as in Jeremiah and Kings.

decisions.choice: "príncipes" (L); "jefes" (B); "dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Spanish wording for human sarim in the prophets, also in 9:8

source.text: לְךָ֤ אֲדֹנָי֙ הַצְּדָקָ֔ה וְלָ֛נוּ בֹּ֥שֶׁת הַפָּנִ֖ים כַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לְאִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וּלְיוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּֽלְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים וְהָרְחֹקִ֗ים בְּכָל־הָֽאֲרָצוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִדַּחְתָּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם בְּמַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָֽעֲלוּ־בָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: To you, Lord, [belongs] the righteousness, and to us shame of the faces as this day, to [the] men of Judah and to [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem and to all Israel, the near and the far, in all the lands where you have banished them there, in their unfaithfulness which they acted unfaithfully against you.

en.L: To {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Lord, belongs righteousness, but to us shame of face, as on this day: to the men of Judah, to those who live in Jerusalem, and to all Israel, those near and those far away, in all the lands to which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have driven them, because of their unfaithfulness which they committed against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Lord, righteousness belongs to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, but to us belongs open shame, as it is today: to the people of Judah, the residents of Jerusalem and all Israel, near and far away, in all the lands where {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have scattered them because of the unfaithfulness they have shown {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Lord, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} always do what is right. But we are covered with shame, as we are today. This is true of the people of Judah and of Jerusalem, and of all Israel, both near and far away. You have scattered them in all the countries of the world, because they have been unfaithful to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

pt.L: A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, Senhor, [pertence] a justiça, mas a nós, a vergonha do rosto, como neste dia: aos homens de Judá, e aos moradores de Jerusalém, e a todo o Israel, aos de perto e aos de longe, em todas as terras para onde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} os expulsaste, por causa da infidelidade que cometeram contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Senhor, a justiça pertence a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, mas a nós pertence a vergonha estampada no rosto, como se vê hoje: ao povo de Judá, aos moradores de Jerusalém e a todo o Israel, aos de perto e aos de longe, em todas as terras por onde {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} os espalhaste por causa da infidelidade que cometeram contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: Senhor, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sempre fazes o que é justo. Mas nós estamos cobertos de vergonha, como estamos hoje. Isso vale para o povo de Judá e de Jerusalém, e para todo o Israel, tanto os que estão perto como os que estão longe. Tu os espalhaste por todos os países do mundo, porque eles foram infiéis a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: À {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur, la justice, et à nous la honte du visage, comme en ce jour : aux hommes de Juda, et aux habitants de Jérusalem, et à tout Israël, ceux qui sont proches et ceux qui sont loin, dans tous les pays où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as chassés, à cause de leur infidélité qu’ils ont commise envers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Seigneur, à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} la justice, mais à nous la honte qui couvre notre visage, comme on le voit aujourd’hui : aux gens de Juda, aux habitants de Jérusalem et à tout Israël, proches ou lointains, dans tous les pays où {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as dispersés à cause de l’infidélité qu’ils ont commise envers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Seigneur, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais toujours ce qui est juste. Mais nous, nous sommes couverts de honte, comme on le voit aujourd’hui. C’est vrai pour les gens de Juda et de Jérusalem, et pour tout Israël, proches ou lointains. Tu les as dispersés dans tous les pays du monde, parce qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont été infidèles.

es.L: A {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, Señor, [pertenece] la justicia, pero a nosotros la vergüenza del rostro, como en este día: a los hombres de Judá, a los habitantes de Jerusalén y a todo Israel, a los de cerca y a los de lejos, en todas las tierras adonde los has arrojado, por la infidelidad que cometieron contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Señor, la justicia es {{deity_pronoun:tuya|Tuya}}, pero a nosotros nos corresponde la vergüenza pública, como sucede hoy: a la gente de Judá, a los habitantes de Jerusalén y a todo Israel, cerca y lejos, en todos los países adonde los has dispersado por la infidelidad que han cometido contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Señor, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} siempre haces lo que es justo. Pero nosotros estamos cubiertos de vergüenza, como lo estamos hoy. Esto vale para la gente de Judá y de Jerusalén, y para todo Israel, los que están cerca y los que están lejos. Los has dispersado por todos los países del mundo, porque {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} han sido infieles.

sw.L: Kwako, Bwana, ni haki, lakini kwetu ni aibu ya uso, kama ilivyo leo: kwa watu wa Yuda, na kwa wakaao Yerusalemu, na kwa Israeli wote, walio karibu na walio mbali, katika nchi zote ulikowafukuzia, kwa sababu ya kukosa uaminifu kwao, walipokukosea.
sw.B: Bwana, haki ni {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, lakini aibu ya wazi ni yetu, kama ilivyo leo: watu wa Yuda, wakazi wa Yerusalemu na Israeli wote, walio karibu na walio mbali, katika nchi zote ulikowatawanya kwa sababu hawakuwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.R: Bwana, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutenda yaliyo haki siku zote. Lakini sisi tumejaa aibu, kama tulivyo leo. Ndivyo ilivyo kwa watu wa Yuda na wa Yerusalemu, na kwa Israeli wote, walio karibu na walio mbali. Umewatawanya katika nchi zote za dunia, kwa sababu hawakuwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.

vi.L: Lạy Chúa, sự công chính thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, còn sự hổ mặt thuộc về chúng con như ngày nay: thuộc về những người Giu-đa, những người ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, và toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên, những người ở gần và những người ở xa, trong mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đuổi họ đến, vì sự bất trung họ đã phạm cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy Chúa, sự công chính thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, còn chúng con thì phải hổ mặt như ngày nay: người Giu-đa, cư dân Giê-ru-sa-lem và toàn thể Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù ở gần hay ở xa, trong mọi xứ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho họ tản lạc đến, vì sự bất trung họ đã phạm cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy Chúa, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn làm điều công chính. Còn chúng con thì phải chịu xấu hổ như ngày nay. Người Giu-đa, người ở Giê-ru-sa-lem và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đều như vậy, dù họ ở gần hay ở xa. Ngài đã làm cho họ tản lạc khắp các nước trên thế giới, vì họ đã bất trung với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님, 의는 주님께 [있고], 오늘과 같이 얼굴의 수치는 저희에게, 곧 유다 사람들과 예루살렘 주민들과 온 이스라엘에게, 가까이 있는 자들과 멀리 있는 자들에게, 주님께서 그들을 쫓아내신 모든 땅에서 [있습니다]. 그들이 주님께 저지른 배신 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주님, 의는 주님께 있으나, 오늘 이렇게 수치를 당하는 것은 저희입니다. 유다 사람들과 예루살렘 주민들과 온 이스라엘, 곧 가까이 있는 이들이나 멀리 있는 이들이나, 그들이 주님께 저지른 배신 때문에 주님께서 흩으신 모든 나라에 있는 이들이 다 그러합니다.
ko.R: 주님, 주님은 언제나 옳은 일을 하십니다. 그러나 저희는 오늘 이렇게 부끄러움을 당하고 있습니다. 유다 사람들과 예루살렘 사람들과 온 이스라엘이 다 그렇습니다. 가까이 있는 사람들이나 멀리 있는 사람들이나 다 그렇습니다. 그들이 주님께 신실하지 않았기 때문에 주님께서 그들을 세상 모든 나라로 흩으셨습니다.

decisions.choice: to you belongs righteousness, to us shame: God is in the right; the people are guilty
decisions.reason: Daniel does not accuse God for the ruin of Jerusalem. He confesses that God has been right in all he has done, and that the shame on the people's faces is deserved (verse 14; Nehemiah 9:33; Ezra 9:15).

decisions.choice: shame of face, as at this day: the open disgrace they bear now
decisions.reason: Shame shows on the face (2 Chronicles 32:21; Jeremiah 7:19). "As at this day" means as can be seen now (Deuteronomy 29:27; Jeremiah 44:22).

decisions.choice: unfaithfulness: breach of trust against God
decisions.reason: The word means acting treacherously, breaking faith, as with something that belongs to God (Leviticus 26:40; 1 Chronicles 10:13).

decisions.choice: righteousness (L, B); you always do what is right (R); men of Judah (L), people of Judah (B, R)
decisions.reason: Righteousness follows the Isaiah table. Readable says what it means of God here (m1). The men of Judah means its people, and Balanced and Readable say so; it is not a gender span because it names the people of one land.

decisions.choice: you (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: Daniel's prayer speaks to God as "you" and about him as "he"; every such pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting, except at the start of a sentence.

decisions.choice: "la honte du visage" (L), "la honte qui couvre notre visage" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew image; Balanced keeps the face, which French also uses for open shame ("le rouge au visage"), with a verb that makes it read naturally.

decisions.choice: "얼굴의 수치" (L); "수치를 당하다" (B); "부끄러움을 당하다" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "shame of face"; Balanced and Readable say the open disgrace plainly.

source.text: יְהוָ֗ה לָ֚נוּ בֹּ֣שֶׁת הַפָּנִ֔ים לִמְלָכֵ֥ינוּ לְשָׂרֵ֖ינוּ וְלַאֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh, to us [belongs] shame of the faces, to our kings, to our leaders and to our fathers, who have sinned against you.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, shame of face [belongs] to us, to our kings, to our princes and to our fathers, for we have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, open shame belongs to us, to our kings, our officials and our ancestors, because we have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, we are covered with shame, and so are our kings, our leaders and our ancestors. We have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a nós [pertence] a vergonha do rosto, aos nossos reis, aos nossos príncipes e aos nossos pais, porque pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a vergonha estampada no rosto pertence a nós, aos nossos reis, aos nossos oficiais e aos nossos antepassados, porque pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nós estamos cobertos de vergonha, e também os nossos reis, os nossos líderes e os nossos antepassados. Pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à nous la honte du visage, à nos rois, à nos chefs et à nos pères, parce que nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à nous la honte qui couvre le visage, à nos rois, à nos dignitaires et à nos ancêtres, parce que nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, nous sommes couverts de honte, et nos rois, nos chefs et nos ancêtres aussi. Nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, a nosotros [pertenece] la vergüenza del rostro, a nuestros reyes, a nuestros príncipes y a nuestros padres, porque hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, a nosotros nos corresponde la vergüenza pública, y a nuestros reyes, a nuestros jefes y a nuestros antepasados, porque hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, estamos cubiertos de vergüenza, y también nuestros reyes, nuestros dirigentes y nuestros antepasados. Hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aibu ya uso [ni] yetu, ya wafalme wetu, ya wakuu wetu na ya baba zetu, kwa sababu tumekutenda dhambi.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aibu ya wazi ni yetu, na ya wafalme wetu, maafisa wetu na mababu zetu, kwa sababu tumekutenda dhambi.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tumejaa aibu, sisi na wafalme wetu, viongozi wetu na mababu zetu. Tumekutenda dhambi.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, sự hổ mặt thuộc về chúng con, về các vua của chúng con, các thủ lĩnh của chúng con và tổ phụ chúng con, vì chúng con đã phạm tội cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chúng con phải hổ mặt, cả các vua, các quan chức và tổ tiên của chúng con nữa, vì chúng con đã phạm tội cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chúng con thật xấu hổ, và các vua, các nhà lãnh đạo và tổ tiên của chúng con cũng vậy. Chúng con đã phạm tội với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 얼굴의 수치는 저희에게, 저희 왕들과 저희 고관들과 저희 조상들에게 [있습니다]. 저희가 주님께 죄를 지었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희가 주님께 죄를 지었기 때문에, 저희와 저희 왕들과 관리들과 조상들이 이렇게 수치를 당합니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희는 부끄러움을 당하고 있습니다. 저희 왕들과 지도자들과 조상들도 그렇습니다. 저희가 주님께 죄를 지었기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: because we have sinned: the reason for the shame
decisions.reason: The word that begins the last clause gives the reason for the shame: "because" or "for". The kings, leaders and fathers are counted together with "us" in the sin.

decisions.choice: LORD as a vocative, with no "O"
decisions.reason: The divine name addressed directly is written as the vocative span with no "O", as in the Psalms and the prophets.

decisions.choice: you (deity pronoun)
decisions.reason: Daniel's prayer speaks to God as "you" and about him as "he"; every such pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting, except at the start of a sentence.

decisions.choice: SENHOR in the vocative, without the article
decisions.reason: The divine name addressed directly has no article inside the span, as Nehemiah 1:5 has it in Portuguese ("Por favor, SENHOR"), so both options read naturally.

decisions.choice: "Ee BWANA" for the vocative, with the span on BWANA
decisions.reason: The vocative of the published Psalms and of the Isaiah-Jeremiah term sheet; the English drops "O", but Swahili addresses God with "Ee".

decisions.choice: "Lạy CHÚA" for the vocative, with no "Ôi"
decisions.reason: The Isaiah and Jeremiah note: "lạy CHÚA" with no "O", as 2 Kings 19:15.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여" as the vocative, with the particle outside the span
decisions.reason: The vocative the term sheet sets for prayers in these books; both forms of the span end in a vowel, so "여" fits both.

decisions.choice: the vocative "SEÑOR" / "Yahvé", with no "oh"
decisions.reason: YHWH addressed directly, as in the published Psalms

source.text: לַֽאדֹנָ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הָרַחֲמִ֖ים וְהַסְּלִח֑וֹת כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְנוּ בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: To [the] Lord our God [belong] the compassions and the forgivenesses, for we have rebelled against him,

en.L: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}
en.B: But the Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: But {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, Lord our God, are kind and forgiving, even though we have turned against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

pt.L: Ao Senhor nosso Deus [pertencem] as misericórdias e os perdões, pois nos rebelamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}
pt.B: Mas o Senhor nosso Deus tem compaixão e perdoa, embora nos tenhamos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Mas {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, Senhor nosso Deus, és bondoso e perdoas, mesmo que nós tenhamos nos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

fr.L: Au Seigneur notre Dieu les compassions et les pardons, car nous nous sommes révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}
fr.B: Mais le Seigneur notre Dieu est plein de compassion et de pardon, bien que nous nous soyons révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Mais {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, Seigneur notre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pardonnes, même si nous nous sommes révoltés contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

es.L: Al Señor nuestro Dios [pertenecen] la compasión y el perdón, porque nos hemos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}
es.B: Pero el Señor nuestro Dios es compasivo y perdonador, aunque nos hemos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, Señor nuestro Dios, eres compasivo y perdonas, aunque nos hemos rebelado contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

sw.L: Kwa Bwana Mungu wetu [ni] huruma na msamaha, kwa maana tumemwasi
sw.B: Lakini Bwana Mungu wetu ni mwenye huruma na msamaha, ingawa tumemwasi.
sw.R: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Bwana Mungu wetu, u mwenye huruma na husamehe, ingawa tumekuasi.

vi.L: Thuộc về Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con là lòng thương xót và sự tha thứ, vì chúng con đã phản nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}
vi.B: Nhưng Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con đầy lòng thương xót và sẵn lòng tha thứ, dù chúng con đã phản nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng lạy Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhân từ và hay tha thứ, dù chúng con đã chống nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주 저희 하나님께는 긍휼과 용서가 [있습니다]. 참으로 저희가 그분께 반역하였고
ko.B: 그러나 주 저희 하나님께서는 긍휼이 많으시고 용서하시는 분이십니다. 저희가 그분께 반역했는데도 그러하십니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주 저희 하나님, 주님은 자비로우시고 저희를 용서해 주십니다. 저희가 주님께 반역했는데도 그렇게 하십니다.

decisions.choice: for we have rebelled: though, or because, we have rebelled
decisions.reason: The small word that joins the clauses can mean "for" or "though". God's compassion and forgiveness are all the more needed, and all the more great, because the people have rebelled.

decisions.choice: compassion and forgiveness: both plural in the Hebrew
decisions.reason: Both words are plural, a way of speaking of abundant mercy and many acts of forgiveness (Nehemiah 9:17, "a God of forgivenesses"; Psalm 130:4).

decisions.choice: no closing punctuation at the end of the verse (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence runs into verse 10, and Literal joins them with no full stop.

decisions.choice: you, Lord our God (R)
decisions.reason: Daniel speaks about God here in the third person, as in verses 10-14, though he is praying to him. Readable turns it to "you" so that it is clear Daniel is still speaking to God; Literal and Balanced keep "him". The pronoun takes the deity_pronoun setting at every level.

decisions.choice: "les compassions et les pardons" (L), both plural as in the Hebrew
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew plurals the meaning decision notes; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary singular or a verb.

decisions.choice: Literal leaves the sentence open at the end of the verse ("반역하였고"), as the English does, and verse 10 finishes it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew runs on from "we have rebelled" into "and we have not listened"; each verse keeps its own words.

decisions.choice: "긍휼과 용서" (L, B); "자비로우시고 … 용서해 주십니다" (R)
decisions.reason: Rachamim is "긍휼" at Literal and Balanced and "자비" at Readable, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: no closing punctuation at the end of the verse (L)
decisions.reason: As the English L: the sentence goes on into verse 10

source.text: וְלֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּתֽוֹרֹתָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣ן לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ בְּיַ֖ד עֲבָדָ֥יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and not we have listened to [the] voice of Yahweh our God, to walk in his instructions which he set before us by [the] hand of his servants the prophets.

en.L: and we have not listened to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, to walk in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} instructions which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set before us by the hand of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.
en.B: We have not obeyed {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God or lived by the instructions {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} set before us through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants the prophets.
en.R: We have not obeyed {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God. We have not lived by the teachings {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave us through {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants the prophets.

pt.L: e não ouvimos a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, nosso Deus, para andar nas {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} instruções, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pôs diante de nós pela mão dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas.
pt.B: Não obedecemos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, nosso Deus, nem vivemos segundo as instruções que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pôs diante de nós por meio dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} servos, os profetas.
pt.R: Não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} obedecemos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus. Não vivemos de acordo com os ensinamentos que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nos deste por meio dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} servos, os profetas.

fr.L: et nous n’avons pas écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} notre Dieu, pour marcher dans {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} instructions qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mises devant nous par la main de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes.
fr.B: Nous n’avons pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} notre Dieu, et nous n’avons pas suivi les instructions qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a données par {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs les prophètes.
fr.R: Nous ne {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avons pas obéi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu. Nous n’avons pas vécu selon les enseignements que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous as donnés par {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} serviteurs les prophètes.

es.L: y no hemos escuchado la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, para andar en {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} instrucciones, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso delante de nosotros por mano de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas.
es.B: No hemos obedecido {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios ni hemos vivido conforme a las instrucciones que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso delante de nosotros por medio de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} siervos los profetas.
es.R: No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} hemos obedecido, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios. No hemos vivido según las enseñanzas que nos diste por medio de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} siervos los profetas.

sw.L: wala hatukuisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, kwenda katika sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} alizoziweka mbele yetu kwa mkono wa watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} manabii.
sw.B: Hatukumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu wala kuishi kwa mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} aliyoyaweka mbele yetu kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} manabii.
sw.R: Hatukukutii {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu. Hatukuishi kwa mafundisho uliyotupa kupitia watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} manabii.

vi.L: và chúng con đã không nghe tiếng của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, để bước đi trong những lời chỉ dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt trước mặt chúng con qua tay các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.
vi.B: Chúng con đã không vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con, cũng không sống theo những lời chỉ dạy mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt trước mặt chúng con qua các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.
vi.R: Chúng con đã không vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng con. Chúng con đã không sống theo những lời dạy dỗ mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho chúng con qua các đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là các nhà tiên tri.

ko.L: 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 듣지 않았으며, 그분께서 그분의 종 예언자들의 손으로 저희 앞에 두신 그분의 가르침들 안에서 행하지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 저희는 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종하지 않았고, 그분께서 그분의 종 예언자들을 통하여 저희 앞에 주신 가르침대로 살지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 저희는 저희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 주님께 순종하지 않았습니다. 주님께서 주님의 종 예언자들을 통하여 주신 가르침대로 살지 않았습니다.

decisions.choice: listened to the voice: obeyed
decisions.reason: To listen to someone's voice is to obey them (Deuteronomy 13:5; Jeremiah 7:23).

decisions.choice: instructions: God's teachings, the torah
decisions.reason: The plural of the word torah means God's instructions or laws (Exodus 18:16, 20; Jeremiah 44:23). "By the hand of" means through the prophets as his messengers.

decisions.choice: instructions (L, B); teachings (R)
decisions.reason: Torah follows the Isaiah table, "instruction" and "teaching", in the plural here. Readable turns the third person to "you", as in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "instructions" (L, B), "enseignements" (R) for God's torot here
decisions.reason: The plural names the teachings given through the prophets; "instructions" and "enseignements" are the term sheet's words for God's torah at Balanced and Readable, and Literal follows the English, which says "instructions" there too.

decisions.choice: "sheria" (L); "mafundisho" (B, R) for God's torot here; "sheria" at every level for "your law" and "the law of Moses" (9:11, 13)
decisions.reason: The torah rule of the Isaiah-Jeremiah term sheet (sheria at L, mafundisho at B and R). Where the text names the written law of Moses, every level says "sheria", as the English says "law" at every level.

decisions.choice: "những lời chỉ dạy" (L, B); "những lời dạy dỗ" (R) for torot
decisions.reason: The plural torot here are God's instructions given through the prophets; "luật pháp" is kept for "the law of Moses" in verses 11 and 13, as the English keeps "law" there.

decisions.choice: "가르침" for torot at every level
decisions.reason: As the English says "instructions" and as Jeremiah 31:33 renders torah; "율법" stays for the law of Moses in verses 11 and 13.

decisions.choice: "instrucciones" (L, B); "enseñanzas" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for torah as God's teaching (instrucción / enseñanza)

source.text: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עָֽבְרוּ֙ אֶת־תּ֣וֹרָתֶ֔ךָ וְס֕וֹר לְבִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֣וֹעַ בְּקֹלֶ֑ךָ וַתִּתַּ֨ךְ עָלֵ֜ינוּ הָאָלָ֣ה וְהַשְּׁבֻעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר כְּתוּבָה֙ בְּתוֹרַת֙ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עֶֽבֶד־הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And all Israel have transgressed your law and turned aside, not to listen to your voice; and has been poured on us the curse and the oath which [is] written in [the] law of Moses the servant of God, for we have sinned against him.

en.L: And all Israel has transgressed {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} law and turned aside, not listening to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} voice; so the curse and the oath that are written in the law of Moses the servant of God have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: All Israel has broken {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} law and turned away, refusing to obey {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. So the curse and the oath that are written in the law of Moses, the servant of God, have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: All the people of Israel have broken {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} law and turned away. They have refused to obey {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. So the curses that are written in the law of Moses, God's servant, have been poured out on us. That happened because we have sinned against God.

pt.L: E todo o Israel transgrediu a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} Lei e se desviou, não ouvindo a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} voz; por isso se derramaram sobre nós a maldição e o juramento que estão escritos na Lei de Moisés, servo de Deus, porque pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.B: Todo o Israel desobedeceu à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} Lei e se afastou, recusando-se a {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} obedecer. Por isso a maldição e o juramento escritos na Lei de Moisés, servo de Deus, foram derramados sobre nós, porque pecamos contra {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.
pt.R: Todo o povo de Israel desobedeceu à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} Lei e se afastou. Eles se recusaram a {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} obedecer. Por isso as maldições escritas na Lei de Moisés, servo de Deus, foram derramadas sobre nós. Isso aconteceu porque pecamos contra Deus.

fr.L: Et tout Israël a transgressé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi et s’est détourné, sans écouter {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} voix ; et se sont déversés sur nous la malédiction et le serment qui sont écrits dans la Loi de Moïse, serviteur de Dieu, car nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Tout Israël a enfreint {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi et s’est détourné, refusant de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}obéir. Alors la malédiction et le serment écrits dans la Loi de Moïse, serviteur de Dieu, se sont déversés sur nous, parce que nous avons péché contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Tout le peuple d’Israël a désobéi à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi et s’est détourné. Ils ont refusé de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}obéir. Alors les malédictions écrites dans la Loi de Moïse, serviteur de Dieu, se sont déversées sur nous. C’est arrivé parce que nous avons péché contre Dieu.

es.L: Y todo Israel ha transgredido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ley y se ha apartado para no escuchar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voz; por eso se han derramado sobre nosotros la maldición y el juramento que están escritos en la ley de Moisés, siervo de Dios, porque hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Todo Israel ha quebrantado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ley y se ha apartado; no ha querido escuchar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voz. Por eso se han derramado sobre nosotros la maldición y el juramento que están escritos en la ley de Moisés, el siervo de Dios, porque hemos pecado contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Todo el pueblo de Israel ha desobedecido {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ley y se ha apartado. Se han negado a obedecer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dices. Por eso han caído sobre nosotros las maldiciones que están escritas en la ley de Moisés, el siervo de Dios. Eso pasó porque hemos pecado contra Dios.

sw.L: Naye Israeli wote wameivunja sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, wakageuka, wasiisikilize sauti {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; kwa hiyo laana na kiapo vilivyoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa mtumishi wa Mungu vimemiminwa juu yetu, kwa sababu tumemtenda dhambi.
sw.B: Israeli wote wameivunja sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kugeuka mbali, wakakataa kukutii. Kwa hiyo laana na kiapo vilivyoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa, mtumishi wa Mungu, vimemiminwa juu yetu, kwa sababu tumemtenda dhambi.
sw.R: Watu wote wa Israeli wameivunja sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kugeuka mbali. Wamekataa kukutii. Kwa hiyo laana zilizoandikwa katika sheria ya Musa, mtumishi wa Mungu, zimemiminwa juu yetu. Hilo limetokea kwa sababu tumemtenda Mungu dhambi.

vi.L: Và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đã vi phạm luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và xây bỏ, không nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; nên sự nguyền rủa và lời thề đã được chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời, đã đổ xuống trên chúng con, vì chúng con đã phạm tội cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đã vi phạm luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và quay lưng đi, không chịu vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì thế, sự nguyền rủa và lời thề đã được chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời, đã đổ xuống trên chúng con, vì chúng con đã phạm tội cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã vi phạm luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và quay lưng đi. Họ không chịu vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vì vậy những lời nguyền rủa đã chép trong luật pháp của Môi-se, đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời, đã đổ xuống trên chúng con. Điều ấy xảy ra vì chúng con đã phạm tội với Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘이 주님의 율법을 어기고 떠나서 주님의 목소리를 듣지 않았습니다. 그래서 하나님의 종 모세의 율법에 기록된 저주와 맹세가 저희 위에 쏟아졌습니다. 저희가 그분께 죄를 지었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 온 이스라엘이 주님의 율법을 어기고 떠나서 주님께 순종하기를 거부했습니다. 그래서 하나님의 종 모세의 율법에 기록된 저주와 맹세가 저희에게 쏟아졌습니다. 저희가 그분께 죄를 지었기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 온 이스라엘 백성이 주님의 율법을 어기고 떠났습니다. 그들은 주님께 순종하기를 거부했습니다. 그래서 하나님의 종 모세의 율법에 기록된 저주들이 저희에게 쏟아졌습니다. 저희가 하나님께 죄를 지었기 때문에 그렇게 된 것입니다.

decisions.choice: the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses: Leviticus 26 and Deuteronomy 28-29
decisions.reason: The law of Moses ends its covenant with blessings for obedience and curses for disobedience, sealed with an oath (Leviticus 26:14-39; Deuteronomy 28:15-68; 29:11, 19-20). Exile and the ruin of the land are among the curses (Deuteronomy 28:36, 64; 29:27). Daniel sees them fulfilled.

decisions.choice: your law: God's torah, here the law given through Moses
decisions.reason: Here the word means the written law as a whole, as "the law of Moses" later in the verse shows.

decisions.choice: law (all levels); the law of Moses the servant of God (all levels)
decisions.reason: Torah is "instruction" in the prophets' table, but "the law of Moses" is the wording published for this phrase (Ezra 3:2; Malachi 3:22), and "your law" here means the same written law, so every level says "law". "Servant" is kept at every level, as in Malachi 3:22.

decisions.choice: the curses (R); God (R)
decisions.reason: Readable joins "the curse and the oath" as "the curses" and names God where the Hebrew says "him".

decisions.choice: a tua Lei; a Lei de Moisés (capital L)
decisions.reason: "Your law" here is the written Law of Moses (m2), which Portuguese capitalizes, as Nehemiah's Portuguese writes "a Lei de Moisés"; the two phrases in the verse are the same law, so both take the capital.

decisions.choice: "ta loi" at every level; "la Loi de Moïse" with a capital
decisions.reason: As the term sheet sets for Daniel 9:11, 13: here God's torah is the law given through Moses, so "loi" holds at every level, and "la Loi de Moïse" takes the capital it has in the New Testament.

decisions.choice: "율법" at every level for the law given through Moses
decisions.reason: Here torah is the law of Moses, which Korean calls "율법"; the same word holds in verse 13.

decisions.choice: "ley" at every level
decisions.reason: Here torah is the law given through Moses, so all levels say "ley", as the English does; "siervo" for Moses at every level

source.text: וַיָּ֜קֶם אֶת־דְּבָר֣וֹ׀אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר עָלֵ֗ינוּ וְעַ֤ל שֹֽׁפְטֵ֨ינוּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁפָט֔וּנוּ לְהָבִ֥יא עָלֵ֖ינוּ רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־נֶעֶשְׂתָ֗ה תַּ֚חַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he has carried out his words which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us calamity great, which not has been done under all the heavens as has been done in Jerusalem.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has fulfilled {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, bringing on us great calamity; for under the whole heaven nothing has been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.
en.B: He has carried out the warnings {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke against us and against our rulers who governed us, by bringing on us a great disaster. Nowhere under heaven has anything been done like what was done to Jerusalem.
en.R: You did what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would do to us and to our rulers. You brought a terrible disaster on us. Nothing anywhere in the world has ever been as bad as what happened to Jerusalem.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} cumpriu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} palavra, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou contra nós e contra os nossos juízes que nos julgavam, trazendo sobre nós um grande mal; pois debaixo de todo o céu nada foi feito como o que foi feito a Jerusalém.
pt.B: Ele cumpriu as advertências que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez contra nós e contra os nossos governantes, trazendo sobre nós uma grande desgraça. Em nenhum lugar debaixo do céu se fez algo como o que foi feito a Jerusalém.
pt.R: Tu fizeste o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tinhas dito que farias contra nós e contra os nossos governantes. Trouxeste sobre nós uma desgraça terrível. Nada em nenhum lugar do mundo foi tão ruim quanto o que aconteceu a Jerusalém.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a accompli {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} paroles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait prononcées contre nous et contre nos juges qui nous ont jugés, en faisant venir sur nous un grand malheur ; car sous tous les cieux il n’a rien été fait de semblable à ce qui a été fait à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Il a exécuté les menaces qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait prononcées contre nous et contre ceux qui nous gouvernaient, en faisant venir sur nous un grand malheur. Nulle part sous le ciel on n’a rien fait de pareil à ce qui a été fait à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Tu as fait ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} avais dit que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nous ferais, à nous et à nos chefs. Tu as fait venir sur nous un terrible malheur. Nulle part dans le monde il n’est jamais rien arrivé d’aussi terrible qu’à Jérusalem.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha cumplido {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra que habló contra nosotros y contra nuestros jueces que nos juzgaron, trayendo sobre nosotros una gran calamidad; porque debajo de todo el cielo no se ha hecho nada como lo que se ha hecho en Jerusalén.
es.B: Él ha cumplido las advertencias que hizo contra nosotros y contra nuestros gobernantes, trayendo sobre nosotros una gran desgracia. En ningún lugar bajo el cielo se ha hecho algo como lo que se hizo en Jerusalén.
es.R: Hiciste lo que habías dicho que nos harías a nosotros y a nuestros gobernantes. Trajiste sobre nosotros una desgracia terrible. Nunca ha pasado en ningún lugar del mundo nada tan malo como lo que pasó en Jerusalén.

sw.L: Naye amelithibitisha neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} alilolisema juu yetu na juu ya waamuzi wetu waliotuhukumu, kwa kuleta juu yetu maafa makubwa; kwa maana chini ya mbingu zote halijafanyika jambo kama lililofanyika Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Ameyatimiza maonyo aliyoyasema dhidi yetu na dhidi ya watawala wetu waliotuongoza, kwa kutuletea maafa makubwa. Hakuna mahali popote chini ya mbingu palipofanyika jambo kama lililofanyika Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Ulifanya yale uliyosema utatufanyia sisi na watawala wetu. Ulituletea maafa makubwa sana. Hakuna kitu chochote duniani kilichowahi kuwa kibaya kama kilichotokea Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm trọn lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng chúng con và nghịch cùng các quan xét đã xét xử chúng con, bằng cách giáng trên chúng con tai họa lớn; vì dưới cả bầu trời chưa từng có điều gì được làm như điều đã được làm cho Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Ngài đã thực hiện những lời cảnh cáo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán nghịch cùng chúng con và các nhà cai trị đã cai quản chúng con, khi giáng trên chúng con một tai họa lớn. Khắp dưới trời, chưa từng có nơi nào phải chịu điều như Giê-ru-sa-lem đã chịu.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm đúng như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán sẽ làm cho chúng con và cho các nhà cai trị của chúng con. Ngài đã giáng trên chúng con một tai họa khủng khiếp. Không nơi nào trên thế giới từng phải chịu điều tồi tệ như điều đã xảy ra cho Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 그분께서는 저희와 저희를 다스리던 저희 재판관들에게 하신 그분의 말씀을 이루시어, 저희에게 큰 재앙을 내리셨습니다. 온 하늘 아래에서 예루살렘에 행해진 것과 같은 일이 행해진 적이 없었습니다.
ko.B: 그분께서는 저희와 저희를 다스리던 통치자들에게 경고하신 말씀을 그대로 이루시어, 저희에게 큰 재앙을 내리셨습니다. 하늘 아래 어디에서도 예루살렘에 일어난 것과 같은 일이 일어난 적이 없습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 저희와 저희 통치자들에게 하시겠다고 말씀하신 일을 그대로 하셨습니다. 주님께서 저희에게 끔찍한 재앙을 내리셨습니다. 세상 어디에서도 예루살렘에 일어난 일만큼 끔찍한 일은 없었습니다.

decisions.choice: our judges who judged us: our rulers
decisions.reason: "Judges" here means all who governed Israel, kings and officials, as in Psalm 2:10 and Amos 2:3.

decisions.choice: nothing like what has been done to Jerusalem: the language of Lamentations
decisions.reason: Lamentations asks whether there is any sorrow like Jerusalem's (Lamentations 1:12; 2:13). The calamity of 587 BC was the curse of the covenant in full.

decisions.choice: the warnings (B); what you said you would do (R)
decisions.reason: The words God spoke against them are the warnings of the law and the prophets; Balanced and Readable say so. Readable turns the third person to "you", as in verse 9.

decisions.choice: "Ngài" throughout (R)
decisions.reason: The English Readable turns to "you" here; Vietnamese "Ngài" already serves for God both spoken to and spoken of, so the change of person needs no other word.

decisions.choice: "저희를 다스리던 저희 재판관들" (L); "통치자들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The judges here are the people's rulers, as the meaning decision says; Literal keeps the word, the other levels give its sense.

source.text: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את בָּ֣אָה עָלֵ֑ינוּ וְלֹֽא־חִלִּ֜ינוּ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ לָשׁוּב֙ מֵֽעֲוֺנֵ֔נוּ וּלְהַשְׂכִּ֖יל בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: As [is] written in [the] law of Moses, all the calamity this has come on us; and not we have entreated the face of Yahweh our God by turning from our iniquity and by giving attention to your truth.

en.L: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this calamity has come upon us; yet we have not entreated the face of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God by turning back from our iniquities and paying attention to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth.
en.B: All this disaster has come on us, as the law of Moses says it would. Yet we have not pleaded for the favor of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God by turning away from our sins and paying attention to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth.
